summary: John Wiley & Sons, Inc. filed an 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 to announce a quarterly cash dividend increase from $1.42 to $1.43 per share annually, marking the 33rd consecutive annual increase. The dividend of $0.3575 per share is payable on July 23, 2026, to shareholders of record on July 7, 2026. This is a routine dividend declaration with no special-situation event such as a merger, acquisition, or restructuring. The filing is routine and does not fall under any special-situations category.
